column4: that which is put in to fill
have the gospel preached to them
and took him by the throat
to the sick of the palsy
to the goodman of the house
as soon as it was sprung up
such things as are set before
he passed by on the other side
and passed by on the other side
of such things as ye have
Be thou plucked up by the root
shall they cause to be put to death
unto the governor of the feast
of those things in the which
shall they be broken to shivers
